sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No. 3388 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in FIR No.503 of 2019 on the file of the Station House Officer, Tadepalli Police Station, Guntur Urban,
against the petitioners for the offence punishable under Sections 270, and 273 IPC and sections 56,
57(1) and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that this matter is squarely covered by the common order passed in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioners.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in FIR No.503 of 2019 on the file of the Station House Officer, Tadepalli Police Station, Guntur Urban, against the petitioners are hereby quashed; consequently no further action is necessary in the facts of the case.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
_________________ JUSTICE D.RAMESH
26th August, 2020 Mjl/* HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE D.RAMESH CRIMINAL PETITION No. 3388 of 2020 ( allowed) 26.08.2020
